shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files | rg 'conversation.*spec|specs/.*/spec.md|\\.test\\.' | head -100 && printf '\\n--- dod ---\\n' && cat .lore/dod.md && printf '\\n--- commands ---\\n' && cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md; printf '\\n--- protocol relevant anchors ---\\n'; rg -n \"conversation|list_conversations|history\" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md; printf '\\n--- lore ---\\n'; ls -la .lore; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; printf '\\n--- package scripts ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- history tests ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' src/infrastructure/stores/inMemoryConversationList.test.ts; sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/|spec:\" scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs scripts/lore-run-test.mjs scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs | head -80; git status --short; sed -n '1,100p' src/infrastructure/stores/inMemorySessionStore.ts; rg -n \"new InMemorySessionStore\" src/transport/ws/*.test.ts | head"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; nl -ba specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | tail -10; git status --short; git branch --show-current; git remote -v"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/transport/ws/messageHandler.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test: define websocket conversation list acceptance" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb'
